seo.title: Stand | Branded games for trade shows and activations
seo.description: Create participatory brand experiences for trade shows and activations: games that improve each visitor's event experience and open conversations, with optional contact capture.

hero.subtitle: Stand helps brands and agencies bring their spaces to life with customizable games that invite people to take part, improve the event experience, and can open conversations through optional contact forms.
hero.microcopy: For trade shows and activations. Contact capture is optional.
hero.visualAlt: Horizontal and vertical touchscreens for in-person activations
hero.visualCaption: Screens for in-person activations. Hardware is offered as an add-on service.

about.intro: For brands and agencies at trade shows and activations, Stand turns a passing moment into a participatory brand experience: a game to enjoy and an opportunity to start a conversation.

pillars.title: An experience to remember
pillars.description: Offer a clear, participatory activity that adds an enjoyable moment to a visit and fits the atmosphere of your event.

pillars.title: Your brand in the game
pillars.description: Customize the game's visual look and, depending on the plan, adapt its content and mechanics to your activation.

pillars.title: Optional conversations and contacts
pillars.description: If it fits your activity, enable optional participant forms and review or export the available results.

about.problemTitle: A visitor can simply pass by
about.problemBody: At a trade show, many people walk past and the conversation can stop at the booth. A participatory experience gives them a reason to pause, enjoy a game, and start talking.

howItWorks.title: From an idea to a participatory experience
howItWorks.subtitle: Choose a game, make it yours, and decide how you want to invite people to take part.

steps.title: Choose a game
steps.description: Pick an experience from the catalog based on the kind of interaction you want at your trade show or activation.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description: Customize the game's visual look. For a tailored proposal, ask about design and adaptation options.

steps.title: Invite people to play
steps.description: Welcome visitors to the game and, if needed, configure optional participant forms to support follow-up after the event.

catalog.subtitle: Games with different mechanics for trade shows and activations. Customize the visual experience to fit your brand.

items.question: What is Stand?
items.answer: Stand is a platform of customizable games for brands and agencies planning trade shows and activations. Its activities invite people to take part and can help start conversations with visitors.

items.question: Can I collect participant contacts?
items.answer: The Event plan includes optional forms that you configure in the dashboard. You decide whether they fit your event activity; basic results can also be viewed and exported.

items.question: Can I adapt the games to my brand?
items.answer: Plans include visual customization options. Enterprise offers custom design and content or mechanic adaptation as optional services.

items.question: How much does Stand cost for an event?
items.answer: Starter is free and includes one active game and up to 25 players. Event costs €24 for 24 hours or €99 for 7 days, as a one-time payment. Enterprise starts at €99; optional services are quoted separately.

items.question: What kinds of games are available?
items.answer: The catalog includes word challenges, a prize or challenge wheel, reflex games, activities that connect participants, quizzes, and visual content cards.

items.question: What can an Enterprise proposal include?
items.answer: Optional services include touchscreens and interactive setups, logistics, design, content adaptation, post-event analytics, staff, or prizes. The scope and price are defined in the proposal.
